1.0.1: This resource uses Newb_Bridge going forward.
ox_inventory tint kits (1-7) plus a serial file that strips weapon serials. MK2 weapons remap tint ids when the item name contains MK2.
New item images, notifications through the bridge, and the usual folder cleanup.
1.0.4: No gameplay changes in this update.

1.7.3: The code is reorganised into modules, and the open settings file moved to resource/open/shared/config.lua. Move any edits you made in the old configs/config.lua across.
The README now covers the five carrier tiers, the plate HUD, the management menu and the police serial check, with the keys for each. Text is translated into 29 languages.

1.0.4: Two players can no longer collect rewards from the same plant at the same time.
Picking and selling now have cooldowns and logging. The server checks that players are near the plant or vendor they are using.
The premade fields now have at most 5 positions per plant type. Add more in the config if you want them.
The config has moved to resource/open/shared/config.lua.
Custom integrations must update calls to the renamed MrNewbOrganics events.

3.2.1: New handheld GPS interface with a keypad and a status line.
Release downloads now include only the compiled UI.
The config has moved to resource/open/shared/config.lua.

1.0.2: The main config has moved to resource/open/shared/config.lua.
The server-only loot pools and scavenger locations have moved to resource/open/server/config.lua.

1.5.3: Two players can no longer buy the same buy-back stock at once. Stock stays available if a purchase fails.
Selling, buying and smelting now have cooldowns and logging, and the server checks distance and amounts.
Custom integrations must use the renamed stock callback, MrNewbPawn:server:requestedStock.

3.2.0: The plate menu now shows the nearest vehicle's current plate as the placeholder text, so you can tell which car you are fitting when several are close.
The description names the vehicle model, for example "Fitting a new plate to the Sultan".
New Config.MaxInteractDistance sets how close you must be to the vehicle (default 10.0). The server allows 2.0 extra for lag.
MrNewb Scripts logo added to the plate menu.
Added the Lithuanian locale (lt), so every locale Newb_Bridge supports is covered, and translated the new description line in all of them.
Thanks to Sarpheim for suggesting the vehicle placeholder, model name and distance config.
The compiled UI changed, so restart the resource after updating.

3.0.4: Fixed records clerks failing to appear when a character loads. Clerks are removed when the character unloads.
Release downloads now include only the compiled UI.
3.0.5: The date on the certificate and the cooldown messages now read their month names and time units from the locale files.
Locale files are included for every language Newb_Bridge supports.

0.2.2: Updated to new folder format, added new images, slight cleanup, compatibility with current bridge.
Also you can save some $ on my paid scripts if you dont have them, use coupon code NEWCUSTOMER10 at https://mrnewbscripts.tebex.io/
0.4.0: This resource uses Newb_Bridge going forward.
Weighted loot tables plus job payout tables. Config is server-only so weights and payout ranges never hit the client.
shared = true pulls that row out of the live table after it hits once (server-wide). GetLootRoll / GetJobPayout / RegisterLootTable exports for other resources.
Trimmed unused example tables. Chance is an ox_lib selector weight, not a percent.

1.1.2: New opening animation: the player kneels, sets the present on the ground, and it bursts into confetti when it opens.
The server-only config has moved to resource/open/server/config.lua.
1.1.4: The script now checks at startup that ox_lib is 3.40.2 or newer. If it is older, the server console prints a red message with the version it found and where to update, instead of failing later with errors such as 'attempt to index a function value (field selector)'.

1.0.4: Discord application posts now show the job, the applicant and their answers in a card. Long answers are shortened to fit.
Job, ID card and application requests now have cooldowns and logging. The server checks desk distance, available jobs and prices.
Fixed the city hall ped spawning partly underground.
All Discord message text can now be translated through the locale file.
Locale files now load through ox_lib.
Update custom integrations to use the renamed MrNewbCityHall callbacks.
When the resource stops, active rentals are refunded and their paperwork and keys are removed.
Custom integrations must update calls to the renamed MrNewbVehicleRentals events.
The config has moved to resource/open/shared/config.lua.

0.13.5: Added missing command registration support for the Qbox framework module. Thanks @PeppeSess.
Added support for MSK Scripts (msk_core). Thanks @Musiker.
Improved SQL handler security against improper third-party usage and deprecated the SQL handler module.

2.2.3: Patched some locales, shipping the extra locales missed last time.

0.1.3: Banking: added support for lation_banking. It is detected automatically, or set Config.Banking to lation_banking.
Locales: any text missing from the language you run now falls back to English instead of showing an empty or raw key.
The French locale gained the new zone creator labels (place the zone, finish, undo the last zone).
Inventory: asking for an item that does not exist in an inventory's item list now correctly reports it as missing instead of treating the whole list as one item.
0.1.4: Boss menu: added support for lation_jobs, ShitDevScripts-Bossmenu and apex_bossmenu. They are detected automatically, or set Config.BossMenu to the resource name.
Banking: added support for ShitDevScripts-Banking. It is detected automatically, or set Config.Banking to ShitDevScripts-Banking.
Thanks to Rastalum and GR-Scripts for the contributions.

2.5.6: The script now checks at startup that ox_lib is 3.40.2 or newer and Newb_Bridge is 0.1.3 or newer. If either is older, the server console prints a red message with the version it found and where to update, instead of failing later with errors such as 'attempt to index a function value (field selector)' when adding a queen.
The install guide and the [INSTALL] README now list the minimum ox_lib and Newb_Bridge versions.
The admin hive list's Previous and Next buttons and their screen reader labels now come from the locale files in every language.

Fixed a one-time client error when the script is restarted while players are online, where the honey separator could fail to appear. Players now load the separators themselves once the script is ready.

1.1.3: Fixed the arcade, Go-Kart and About screens reading colours and animation settings from the locale files. Translations can no longer break them, and they no longer do a text lookup every frame.
Players who have animations turned off in Windows now get a calmer toy: the hatch reveal appears at once, the progress toasts fade without popping, and the swim, gift and arcade result effects stop.
DUI display mode: letting go of the printed buttons now registers even if the game window loses focus.
The scrub game stops scrubbing when the pointer is interrupted instead of staying stuck.

Admin setup panel: on/off settings can be toggled by clicking their label, expandable lists report whether they are open or closed to screen readers, and unnamed shop and species rows show a translated 'Untitled' label.
The setup panel text is now sized in rem so it scales with the UI scale.

The script now checks at startup that ox_lib is 3.40.2 or newer. If it is older, the server console prints a red message with the version it found and where to update, instead of failing later with errors such as 'attempt to index a function value (field selector)'.

Internal events are renamed to the resource:side:pastTense form, for example MrNewbDigitalPets:client:usedItem. If you have custom scripts that trigger a MrNewbDigitalPets event directly, update the names.

1.1.2: The setup panel no longer receives the murder log's Discord webhook address. It shows the webhook as set, with only the last four characters, and saving the panel keeps the stored address unless you type a new one.

The starting setup (recycler types, recipes, audio and seed positions) is now built into the script instead of sitting in a configs folder. Everything is set in /setuprecycling, as before, and Reset loads the same starting setup.

The script now checks at startup that ox_lib is 3.40.2 or newer. If it is older, the server console prints a red message with the version it found and where to update, instead of failing later with errors such as 'attempt to index a function value (field selector)'.

1.0.1: A parked trailer whose model is no longer on the server now logs an error naming the model. Before, it was skipped without a word.

1.1.2: RadioIntrusion now uses Newb_Bridge for its framework, inventory and dispatch support.
Players need a radio in their inventory to use the device.
A failed crack sends a dispatch alert to the jobs you set.
Radio channel joins are logged through ox_lib.
The config has moved to resource/open/shared/config.lua.

0.0.4: Players can now do yoga on mats. Completing the poses restores health and reduces stress by a random amount.
Use mats placed around the map, or mat items players put down themselves (up to three each). An optional ped sells the mats.
Sessions are checked on the server: players must be near an unused mat, and a cooldown limits repeat sessions.
Yoga now uses Newb_Bridge for framework and inventory support.

1.0.3: The manifest now declares the server artifact and OneSync it needs, like the other MrNewb scripts.
Updated for the renamed MrNewbVehicleKeys events. It needs MrNewbVehicleKeys 2.10.2 or newer, and says so in the console at startup if Keys is older.

1.1.2: The starting shops, items and locations are now built into the script instead of sitting in a configs folder. Everything is set in the in-game shop creator, as before, and a fresh install still starts with the same shops.

Internal events are renamed to the resource:side:pastTense form, for example MrNewb_Shops:client:openedSettings. If you have custom scripts that trigger a MrNewb_Shops event directly, update the names.
